## Outcome
Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and behavior spec (or explain documentation-only scope).

## Validation
List checks actually run, results, and a reproducible demo. State remaining gaps and risks.

## Review and completion
- [ ] Scope and acceptance criteria satisfied
- [ ] Relevant tests / CI pass
- [ ] Independent review completed (link evidence)
- [ ] Demo recorded or reproducible steps linked

Keep as draft until ready for review. Merge and deployment require their own decision; a draft PR is not Done.
